Use OmniRec for the prototype pipeline and do not install or require LensKit 0.14.4.
Use exactly one local dataset from ../../../study/data/ and exactly one algorithm.
Use a minimal ranking evaluation with one cutoff value and at least one plot.
Load the chosen raw file according to its actual schema and do not download replacement data.
Apply only the dataset-specific implicit-feedback conversion needed for that one chosen dataset.
Apply core filtering only as needed to make the pilot valid.
Use a per-user 80/20 train/test holdout with no validation split.
Set one fixed random seed and use it for both splitting and model training.
Generate top-N recommendations with a finite list length equal to the evaluation cutoff.
Record the exact package versions and the fully qualified algorithm class used.
Record preprocessing counts and train/test interaction counts for reproducibility.
Persist results incrementally so a partial run can be resumed or inspected.
Evaluate only finite metrics computed from actual recommendations; reject empty or placeholder outputs.
